assessments.reasoning: Section 5.3 and Equations (17)–(18) use infinitely often nonstuttering action occurrences, with distinct disabling alternatives for weak and strong fairness.

challenge.method: Re-expressed the two disabling alternatives through their enabling complements and tested a trace with alternating enabled and disabled states and no occurrences.
challenge.results: For weak fairness, infinitely many disabled observations can satisfy the condition without an occurrence. For strong fairness, infinitely many enabled observations rule out permanent disabling, so infinitely many nonstuttering occurrences are required. Continuous enablement from some point requires occurrences under either condition.

limitations: The comparison concerns an asserted fairness condition and the relevant action that changes the specified state function.
